function.name: memory_search
function.description: memory_search is used to find previously stored memories whose key or value contains the given query, case-insensitively. Use it to discover what memories already exist before fetching one with memory_get. An empty query returns every stored memory.

query.description: Text to search for within memory keys and values. Leave empty to list every stored memory.

function.name: memory_get
function.description: memory_get is used to retrieve the value of a previously stored memory by its exact key.

key.description: The exact key of the memory to retrieve.

function.name: memory_put
function.description: memory_put is used to store a memory under a key so it can be retrieved in future sessions. Storing a value under an existing key overwrites it.

key.description: A short, stable key under which to store the memory.

value.description: The value to store, written so it is understandable without any other context.
